comment: The one environment release artifacts are built in. The AppImage carries this system's shared libraries, and scripts/reviewed-library-keys.json lists the private-key blocks of this system's libgnutls by content: on any other system the AppImage would carry other libraries, and verification would rightly refuse them. `npm run release:package` refuses another host before it builds anything, records what it ran on in the manifest, and `release:verify` refuses a manifest of another environment. scripts/release.Containerfile builds this environment from pinned inputs on any Linux host with a container runtime. The packages below are recorded in the manifest (not pinned here): the reviewed-key list binds the one library whose content matters to its bytes.
